The '''vixian mauler''' was a non-sentient species native to the shadow world of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. Immense predators standing several meters tall, vixian maulers had two large arms and a pair of legs strong enough to carry their big bodies. They had two glowing tendrils on top of their heads. [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] and [[Lana Beniko]] killed one vixian mauler during the events of the [[Crisis on Umbara]].<ref name="TOR" />
